title: How Finishing the Rep He Wants to Skip Trains a Godly Man's Self-Control
caption:
God isn't watching the set you post. He's watching the rep you almost skip when nobody's counting.

Self-control isn't a personality trait some men were born with. It's a fruit the Spirit grows one finished rep at a time, one kept promise at a time, one rep nobody saw at a time.

Finish the rep you wanted to skip today. Then finish the rest of your week the same way.

#faith #discipline #selfcontrol #christianmen #manofgod
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
